What are the missions?
SKILLS is a dynamic and specialized recruitment agency based in Rennes, supporting its clients in their search for talent for a variety of positions across diverse sectors. Our expertise allows us to find the profiles best suited to the specific needs of each company.

We are looking for an Industrial Management Controller (M/F) on a permanent contract for one of our clients, a food processing group located in Breteil. This position is an opportunity for someone passionate about management control and wishing to develop their career in a stimulating industrial environment.

As part of a newly created position, and reporting to the Senior Industrial Management Controller for the production sites, your main responsibilities will be to manage and analyze production at these two industrial sites.

You will be in charge of preparing the profit and loss statement (P&L), budget control, and will actively participate in budget development and monitoring. You will support the Site Managers in managing industrial performance and calculate the cost of production.

You will also be involved in calculating industrial cost prices and estimating R&D projects (new products). Finally, you will actively participate in the deployment of the Copilote ERP system, contributing to data validation, configuration, testing, and go-live, as well as the implementation of reporting and performance indicators.

- A high-impact role combining structuring projects (ERP, process optimization) with hands-on experience.
- The opportunity to directly influence the performance and organization of production sites.
